ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and limb (b) fails on the driver's own telemetry. The derived driver track never comes closer than 881.64 m to the T4 pickup pin across 79 fixes, while the derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-radius fixes against the 150 m arrival radius that the fee_schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class. A driver who never entered the arrival radius did not arrive at the pickup point.

Limb (c) fails independently of proximity. The longest continuous in-geofence run in the derived arrival block is 0.0 seconds, measured from the (non-existent) first qualifying in-geofence fix, against a required continuous dwell of 480 seconds for an AIRPORT pickup. The required hold was never begun, let alone completed.

Limb (d) fails on the trip record's own terms. The trip was cancelled by the rider with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is none of the three codes limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT), and the record shows no boarding event. Three of the four POL-NS-01 conditions therefore fail, and the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

The 'arrived' marker struck at 16:14:40 is FALSE under POL-NS-05: at the arrival timestamp the driver's trace places him more than 300 m from the pickup pin — his closest approach on the entire trip is 881.64 m, so he was more than 300 m away at every instant of the attempt. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the cancellation fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip should be recorded as a false-arrival event in the ruling's referrals list.

The driver's own words in the chat log confirm the marker was false. Asked at 16:15:40 'where are you? I'm at the T4 pickup door', he answered 'not yet' at 16:16:20 — one minute and forty seconds AFTER he had pressed 'arrived' — and his filed statement says only that he pressed arrived 'so she'd know I was near'. A driver who answers 'not yet' has not arrived; POL-NS-02 is not satisfied and the contested SGD 6.00 is refundable in full. The fare line itself reconciles at SGD 6.00 (the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee and the RYDE_X tier fee), so this is a chargeability failure, not an arithmetic one, and the refund is the whole SGD 6.00.

ledger.claim: The driver's 'holding area' account does not turn this into a wrong-entrance case. POL-NS-03 applies only where the driver was stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pickup pin; his own trace places him between 881.64 m and 1,467.21 m away throughout the attempt, outside that ceiling, so POL-NS-03 is not engaged at all and nothing in it displaces the full refund that POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 give the rider.

No driver compensation can be ordered on these facts. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails on limbs (b), (c) and (d), and POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 displace it and state in terms that no compensation is payable. There is accordingly no driver-side cost for the rider to fund and no basis for leaving the charge in place.

The rider was at the pin and coordinating, not absent: the rider track holds 67 fixes all within 20.23 m of the pickup pin, well inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, and she wrote 'where are you? I'm at the T4 pickup door'. I do not rely on POL-NS-04 for the refund — its limb (b) is not met, because the driver did reply in the chat within 120 seconds (rider's message 16:15:40, driver's reply 16:16:20) — and I say so rather than stretch it. The refund rests on POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06, none of which depends on the rider's conduct.

The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 16:14:40, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 - the requirement that the trip_record contain an 'arrived' event for the trip - is satisfied on the face of the record.

The cancellation fee the ledger actually took is the correct figure for this trip and cannot be impeached on amount: this is an AIRPORT zone-class pickup, the zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is SGD 4.00, and the greater of the two under the fee_schedule resolution rule - SGD 6.00 - is exactly what fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee records, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect available to the rider.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: her locating message ('where are you? I'm at the T4 pickup door') was sent at 16:15:40 and the driver posted a reply at 16:16:20, forty seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 fails and that rider-exonerating route is closed on the chat log itself.

There is no fee-farming pattern to hold against the driver, and the anti-farming check under POL-NS-07 does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 and driver_profile.completed_trips_30d is 95, a ratio of 0.021 against a 0.08 gate, and both limbs of that test are required.

The rider's assertion that the driver 'wanted a surcharge and thought I was a tourist' is not supported anywhere in the record: the chat log is complete and unredacted at three messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, and the driver's only substantive line - 'if wait too long app charge you not me' - states the platform's own wait rule rather than demanding anything, so that element of the claim is unsupported and cannot carry an adverse finding under POL-GEN-03.

ruling.explanation:
Rider — the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. Driver — the charge does not stand and no compensation is payable to you on this trip.

ARRIVAL. The trip record carries an 'arrived' tap at 16:14:40 (EV-TRIP-00614). The GPS trace for this trip (EV-GPS-00614, 79 fixes at 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, weight 1.0) never places the vehicle closer than 881.64 m to the T4 pickup pin at any instant of the attempt (mean 951.64 m, maximum 1,467.21 m), and it records 0 qualifying in-radius fixes against the 150 m arrival radius the fee schedule sets for the AIRPORT zone class. The tap is therefore a FALSE marker under POL-NS-05: you were more than 300 m from the pin when you pressed it.

CHARGEABILITY. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and three limbs fail. Limb (b) fails under POL-NS-02 — no qualifying in-radius fix at any point. Limb (c) fails under POL-NS-06 — the longest continuous in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds against the 480 seconds required for an AIRPORT pickup, a shortfall of 480 seconds; limb (i) accumulation is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-00614-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present, populated advisory. Limb (d) fails because the trip was terminated by the rider with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three codes that limb recognises, and no boarding event is recorded.

YOUR ACCOUNT. Your 'holding area' explanation was considered. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance / wrong block) requires you to have been stationary within 400 m of the pin; your own trace puts you between 881.64 m and 1,467.21 m away throughout, so that clause is not engaged and nothing in it displaces the refund. Your chat line 'not yet', sent 1 min 40 s after the tap, is consistent with the trace. POL-NS-04 does not apply either way — you did reply within 120 seconds (rider 16:15:40, driver 16:16:20) — and the rider does not rely on it.

COMPENSATION. None is payable. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and here it fails on three limbs. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 against 95 completed trips in 30 days, a ratio of 0.021, below both the 4-count and the 0.08-rate gates (both limbs required).

AMOUNT. SGD 6.00 is the sum actually charged (EV-FARE-00614: total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED) and it reconciles with the fee schedule — the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00).

EVIDENCE QUALITY. No POL-NS-08 defect was found: the arrival tap matches a trace fix exactly (no clock skew), there are no sampling gaps, the chat is complete at 3 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare line reconciles. The deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0. The rider_track (67 fixes, all within 20.23 m of the pin) confirms the rider was at the pickup point; it is noted, though the refund does not depend on it.

The rider's suggestion that the driver sought a surcharge or took her for a tourist is not supported by the chat log, which contains no such demand — the driver's message stated the app's wait rule. No adverse finding is made on that point.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record TRP-00614 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-31422, the 'arrived' marker at 16:14:40 having been struck while no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.
